selected_articles.title: Governments award Edgewing first GCAP contract - Janes
key_facts: Edgewing has been awarded the first GCAP contract.
GCAP is a trilateral defence program with potential participation by additional nations including India.
The contract covers key design and engineering activities to accelerate momentum and delivery.
selected_articles.summary: Edgewing has been awarded the first GCAP contract, kicking off the trilateral programme and focusing on design and engineering activities to accelerate momentum and delivery. The GCAP framework indicates potential future participation by other nations, with India discussed as a possible partner.

selected_articles.title: Indian Army charts future of unmanned systems with new technology roadmap
key_facts: The roadmap details 30 types of unmanned aerial systems (UAS) and loitering munitions across five categories.
A technology roadmap was unveiled to guide development and procurement of UAS.
Aims to mass-produce low-cost drones and strengthen India’s drone ecosystem under Make in India / Atmanirbhar Bharat.
Emphasizes greater industry participation from startups, MSMEs and academia.
selected_articles.summary: The Indian Army unveiled a technology roadmap covering 30 UAS and loitering munitions across five categories, alongside a plan to guide development and procurement. The initiative aims to enable mass, affordable drone production and boost India’s drone ecosystem with wider industry participation under Make in India / Atmanirbhar Bharat.

selected_articles.title: Indian Army launches technology roadmap for Unmanned Aerial System
key_facts: The Indian Army launched a technology roadmap for Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) and loitering munitions.
The roadmap provides clear visibility to industry, academia and R&D institutions to align investments with identified priorities.
Highlights a whole-of-nation approach to building a resilient drone ecosystem.
selected_articles.summary: The Indian Army released a technology roadmap for UAS and loitering munitions, outlining priority areas and providing actionable visibility to industry, academia and research bodies to channel investments. The initiative reinforces a whole-of-nation approach to developing India’s drone ecosystem.
